pages.html:
☁ CloudSync Pro

Simple, Transparent Pricing

Choose the plan that fits your team's needs. All plans include a 14-day free trial.

Starter

$29 /month

Perfect for small teams getting started with cloud synchronization.

  • ✓ Up to 5 team members
  • ✓ 100 GB storage
  • ✓ Basic file sync
  • ✓ Email support
  • ✗ Advanced analytics
  • ✗ API access
  • ✗ SSO integration

Professional

$79 /month

For growing teams that need powerful collaboration tools.

  • ✓ Up to 25 team members
  • ✓ 1 TB storage
  • ✓ Advanced file sync
  • ✓ Priority support
  • ✓ Advanced analytics
  • ✓ API access
  • ✗ SSO integration

Enterprise

Custom contact us

Unlimited scale with dedicated support and custom integrations.

  • ✓ Unlimited team members
  • ✓ Unlimited storage
  • ✓ Real-time collaboration
  • ✓ 24/7 phone support
  • ✓ Custom analytics
  • ✓ Full API access
  • ✓ SSO & audit logs

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I change my plan anytime?

Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect at the start of your next billing cycle. If you upgrade mid-cycle, we'll pro-rate your billing.

Do you offer annual billing discounts?

Absolutely! Pay annually and save 20% on all plans. You'll also receive priority support and early access to new features.

Is there a free trial for all plans?

Yes, all plans include a 14-day free trial with full access to features. No credit card required to start.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers for annual plans.

Can I integrate CloudSync Pro with other tools?

Yes! Professional and Enterprise plans include API access. We also offer pre-built integrations with Slack, Microsoft Teams, Zapier, and many others.

What happens to my data if I cancel?

Your data remains accessible for 30 days after cancellation. You can export all your files at any time before or after cancellation.

Do you offer custom pricing for large teams?

Yes! The Enterprise plan is fully customizable. Contact our sales team at sales@cloudsync.example for a personalized quote.

Is there a minimum contract term?

No, there's no minimum contract. All plans are month-to-month unless you choose annual billing for the 20% discount.
